description_citations.text: "The Moons of Mirrodin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Leonin fight to keep their memories from being pulled into the necrogen mists.
timeline.quote: Mephidross filled with roars of fury and wails of despair as the leonin fought to keep their memories from being pulled into the mists.

citation.text: Necrogen Mists (Mirrodin, 2003), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Leonin capture Slobad and make him a servant of their leader Raksha.
timeline.quote: he was captured by the Leonin and turned into a servant

citation.text: "Slobad", section "Exile". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ushanti recounts a vision of the end of times in which all leonin are torn from the world.
timeline.quote: I have seen the end of times, a future in which all our kind are torn from this world.

citation.text: Soulscour (Darksteel, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The leonin lose their leader Raksha and split into two prides, one supporting the regent kha and one rebelling.
timeline.quote: Left without their leader Raksha, the leonin split into two prides

citation.text: Sunspear Shikari (Scars of Mirrodin, 2010), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: After the Sun's Toll the unified leonin pride fractures into the Kha-Tal and the rebel Obu-Tal.
timeline.quote: Mirrodin's unified pride of leonin fractured into two smaller prides.

citation.text: "The Nonhuman Cultures of Mirrodin". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Dec 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The archons of Trax dominate Theros and conscript the leonin into Agnomakhos's armies.
timeline.quote: the leonin, in particular, were forcibly conscripted into the armies of Agnomakhos .

citation.text: "Oreskos", section "Age of Trax". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The leonin lose to the human rebels Kynaios and Tiro after Ephara gifts mortals with magic, and flee to Oreskos when the archon empire falls.
timeline.quote: As the empire of the archons fell, the leonin fled to Oreskos.

citation.text: "Oreskos", section "Age of Trax". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Suffering under the archons and feeling abandoned by the gods, the leonin devote themselves to iconoclasm.
timeline.quote: the leonin devoted themselves to iconoclasm or the rejection of divine worship.

citation.text: "Oreskos", section "Loss of faith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Leonin destroy Iretis through the secret manipulations of Ashiok and Phenax.
timeline.quote: Destroyed by leonin thanks to the secret manipulations of Ashiok and Phenax

citation.text: "Oreskos", section "Locations in Oreskos's surroundings". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kedarick writes to his estranged wife Klytessa about the coming peace with the leonin.
timeline.quote: The formal signing with the leonin is in a fortnight.

citation.text: "Building Toward a Dream, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Ashiok reports that the leonin are sacking Iretis and that the city now belongs to Phenax.
timeline.quote: The leonin sacking of the city has already begun.

citation.text: "Building Toward a Dream, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Dec 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Ashiok bargains with Phenax and seeks to incite war between Iretis and the leonin.
timeline.quote: they made a bargain with Phenax , the god of lies and deceit

citation.text: "Ashiok", section "Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Posing as Udaen, Ashiok sends nightmare abominations to kill people at a peace meeting; the leonin annihilate Iretis, serving Phenax's plan, and Ashiok asks to be made invisible to the gods.
timeline.quote: The leonin retaliated by annihilating the Iretis' citizenry

citation.text: "Ashiok", section "Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ajani arrives on Theros, becomes a mentor to the leonin and is reunited with Elspeth at Tethmos with Brimaz's help; they swear to set things right.
timeline.quote: Together, they swore an oath to set things right.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Journey into Nyx
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Journey into Nyx". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Lanathos tells the leonin the tale of Polukranos and the Champion of the Sun, who slays the hydra at the Plateau of the Four Winds.
timeline.quote: Polukranos, eater of poleis, beloved of the gods, was no more.

citation.text: "Ajani, Mentor of Heroes" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: At the treaty signing, nightmare creatures appear and kill leonin elders and Kedarick's bodyguards.
timeline.quote: The bodyguard Chelta stabbed the monster's chest

citation.text: "Kedarick VI", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Humans and leonin slaughter each other, each believing the other betrayed them; twelve humans survive.
timeline.quote: the humans and Leonin had started slaughtering each other

citation.text: "Kedarick VI", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Meletis blames Kedarick and declares support for the leonin mission to overthrow him; Akros and Setessa decline aid.
timeline.quote: Meletis formally declared its support for the Leonin mission to overthrow Kedarick

citation.text: "Kedarick VI", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A leonin army marches on Iretis; Ashiok falsely tells Kedarick his wife and child were murdered, and Kedarick stabs out his own eyes.
timeline.quote: Kedarick drew his dagger and stabbed himself first in one eye, then the other

citation.text: "Kedarick VI", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The leonin viewed myr as omens of a sinister fate.
timeline.quote: The leonin thought of the myr as omens, never imagining the sinister fate they foretold.

citation.text: Gold Myr (Neon Dynasty Commander, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Auriok forge a permanent peace with the leonin after a war.
timeline.quote: they managed to forge a permanent peace with them

citation.text: "Auriok", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The leonin establish dominance over the Razor Fields and make Taj-Nar their capital.
timeline.quote: it was chosen as the leonin capital

citation.text: "Razor Fields", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Dakan, the first kha, chooses Taj-Nar, already the largest den, as the leonin capital.
timeline.quote: Dakan , the first kha, chose it as the leonin capital.

citation.text: "Taj-Nar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
